headline: Moody's Flags Rising Credit Risks in Philippine MSME and Retail Loans
summary: Tightening economic conditions and heated inflation have created pockets of stress in Philippine retail and MSME loan segments, risking asset quality deterioration, Moody's Ratings said.
why: Deteriorating asset quality in commercial and retail loan portfolios can increase provisions for credit losses at commercial banks, impacting financial sector stability.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Tightening economic conditions and inflation create stress in MSME and retail loan segments.
